name: @nsnanocat/xml
description: XML / JSON converter with plist support for JavaScriptCore and Node.js
author: VirgilClyne <Virgil@nanocat.me>

scripts.format: biome format --write XML.mjs XML.d.mts test package.json package-lock.json biome.json
scripts.lint: biome check XML.mjs XML.d.mts test package.json package-lock.json biome.json
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm test && npm run typecheck && npm pack --dry-run
